why: Found on the demo inbox: a change to a services agreement's terms got a draft and a heads up, because "contract" asks first but "agreement" didn't. Saying yes would change a contract, so he asks first. It's back-and-forth about details, so it isn't a stop (see delivery-moved).

email.subject: Re: consulting agreement
email.body: Hi Sam, thanks for the redline. We're fine with everything except the payment terms: we'd need net 45 instead of net 30. Is that okay on your side? If it is, I'll send the final version for signature.
